authorization.approved_resources: Existing conversation CPU runtime only; no paid resource provisioning or external datasets.
authorization.local_cpu_budget: 15 small trials,1 torch thread each,at most3 workers; estimated15 CPU minutes from250-step pilot.
authorization.max_walltime: Main launcher <=30min; each trial360s training/420s worker.
authorization.user_approval_reference: User 2026-10-17: Ok, perfect, go ahead and run with that. Approves preceding proposed bounded curve-parameter retention study.

data.confirmation_sha256: Fresh seeds990001,990002, offsets10000*mode+delay;arrays hashed in scores
data.dataset_versions: Fresh deterministic synthetic locked-register generator tasks.py
data.research_wide_region_reuse_audit: New task and seeds; no external or historical corpus, teacher, or official test.
data.selection_sha256: Pilot seeds880001,offsets10000*mode+delay; arrays hashed in pilot scores
data.teacher_and_objective: No teacher. CE on visible query tokens only; hidden simulator values never fed to model.
data.train_sha256: Per-trial SHA256 of all actually consumed input/label arrays in TERMINAL.json

decision.next_experiment: Conditional on results; variable depth, language retention and full self-referential updater weights not in this first phase.

deployment.latency_statistics: Not a deployment latency study;training time and process CPU only.
deployment.memory_components: Record actual h/p scalar count plus one shared integer clock. Learned parameters and fixed basis buffers separate; activations excluded.
deployment.prefill_decode_protocol: Sequential reference implementation; no deployment benchmark
deployment.warmup_and_synchronization: No GPU. Timing begins after model and optimizer construction.

design.compute_accounting: Record training wall and process CPU separately; no throughput/scaling claims.
design.control_rationale: Primary context64 isolates parameter modulation from ordinary additional state at equal state/parameters. wide64 controls state budget with simpler cell. gru64 is standard nonlinear GRU with same state and more parameters. fixed48 is zero-extension reference.
design.matching_track: Equal optimizer steps and paired examples; primary also exact parameter and state match. FLOPs and wall not matched.
mechanism_equations: context64 uses identical p updater and parameter shapes but adds both curve fields to candidate coordinates instead of gates/angles.
8 cosine coefficients per field;2 fields over24 adjacent hidden pairs. Curve coordinate indexes hidden pairs, not depth or token time.
design.seed_selection_method: Three consecutive fresh seeds, chosen before main execution; pilot991 excluded.

evaluation.duplicate_policy: Replay all primary endpoints after loading saved checkpoints;require exact saved aggregate equality.
evaluation.mechanism_interventions: After frozen evaluation: zero_p,no_gate,no_mix on adaptive models at256; trained interventions are distribution-shifting diagnostics, not retrained ablations.
evaluation.multiple_comparison_policy: One primary adaptive-context comparison. Other arms, horizons and interventions descriptive; no multiple-comparison significance claim.
evaluation.primary_endpoint: Final step3000;128 independent episodes per mode/delay; final4 queries each. Delays32,256,1024.
evaluation.uncertainty_method: Show every training seed and paired differences. Report mean/range; n=3 cannot establish broad generalization. Per-episode outcomes retained.

evidence.preservation_policy: Code/numeric evidence to own fork draft PR; checkpoints in a companion artifact. Retain pilot and negative results.
evidence.protocol_sha256: External REGISTRATION.json hashes this file to avoid self-hash.

execution.canary_matrix: Independent scalar task oracle;zero extension of both mechanisms;nonzero-controller chunk and causality checks;nonzero gradient numerical check.
execution.cost_estimate: Pilot250steps took2.5-4.6s training per arm. Main expected<20CPUmin including evaluation.
execution.fidelity_tolerances: Exact zero-extension/chunk/causality agreement; finite-difference absolute gradient error<1e-7 float64.
execution.hardware: Existing Linux x86_64 runtime,8-CPU quota,8GiB memory quota;3 workers each1 thread.
execution.source_ownership_and_concurrent_writers: New isolated unique result directory; no other writer; old macOS SSD mount rule pertains to a different host. Current supplied workspace and mandatory durable artifact handling used.

futility_rule: Stop on nonfinite loss, failed numerical fidelity, trial wall>360s, or lost evidence. Retain all results. No tuning after main scores.
hypothesis: Persisting smooth gate/mixing coefficients improves long-delay conditional recall versus allocating exactly the same parameter count and recurrent-state budget to ordinary candidate modulation.
minimum_useful_effect: Mean paired gain >=0.05 accuracy with all3 training seeds positive.
primary_comparator: adaptive64 minus context64; both10144 parameters and64 FP32 state scalars
primary_metric: Final four-query mean accuracy after256 intervening tokens in conflict mode, higher is better.
success_rule: Primary gain >=0.05; all3 paired seed gains positive; adaptive32-token reopened-key accuracy no worse than context by0.02. This supports a follow-up only, not superiority to GRU or language transfer.

training.accessible_history: Whole episode; no truncation within it.
training.checkpoint_selection_rule: Final step3000 only; no best-seed or best-checkpoint selection.
training.document_reset_policy: Reset all state at each newly generated independent episode.
training.optimizer_schedule: AdamW all parameters lr0.003,betas0.9/0.95,decay0.01,grad clip1. Cosine to0.0003 over3000updates; no warmup.
training.state_carry_and_detach: Carry h,p,and clock across every8-input control boundary; full gradients; no intra-episode detach.
training.target_exposures_per_trial: Actual count recorded; exact matching across arms within seed.
